faqs.title: Frequently asked.
faqs.subtitle: Not finding an answer? Reach us directly for a private conversation.

select-listings.q: How does Andersen Properties select its listings?
select-listings.a: Every property we represent is personally evaluated against a set of criteria covering architecture, build quality, location fundamentals, and long-term value. We only take on listings we would confidently recommend to our own network.

off-market.q: Can you help with an off-market property search?
off-market.a: Yes. A significant portion of the properties we facilitate never appear on public listings. If you have specific requirements, our advisors can conduct a discreet search through our private network.

locations.q: Which locations do you currently serve?
locations.a: We operate across eight key Indonesian markets, including Bali, Jakarta, Lombok, and Labuan Bajo, with a focus on areas experiencing sustained demand from both local and international buyers.

international.a: Absolutely. We regularly work with buyers based outside Indonesia and can guide you through foreign ownership structures, nominee arrangements, and the legal framework applicable to your situation.

support.q: What support is provided during the transaction?
support.a: From the initial search through to handover, your dedicated advisor coordinates due diligence, legal review, notarial services, and any post-purchase requirements — so you have a single point of contact throughout.

intro.headline: A different kind of property firm.
intro.paragraph1: Andersen Properties was founded in 2013 with a straightforward belief: that the property market in Indonesia deserved a firm that prioritised quality over quantity, and the client's interests above its own transaction count.
intro.paragraph2: We are a small, deliberately sized team working across eight key markets in Indonesia. We do not handle every type of property. We focus on the exceptional — homes defined by thoughtful architecture, careful construction, and a genuine sense of place.

curation.title: Rigorous Curation
curation.description: We decline the majority of properties presented to us. Only those that meet our criteria for architecture, location, and quality reach our clients.

relationships.title: Genuine Relationships
relationships.description: We operate through relationships, not transactions. The connections we build with clients, agents, and developers are the foundation of what we do.

local.title: Local Depth
local.description: Indonesia is our home market. We have invested years understanding its cities, regulations, and communities — so our clients don't have to start from zero.

confidence.title: Quiet Confidence
confidence.description: We do not shout. We present clearly, advise honestly, and trust that the quality of our work speaks for itself.

team.title: A small team doing considered work.

henrik.name: Henrik Andersen
henrik.bio: Henrik has spent over twelve years working across residential property in Indonesia. He established Andersen Properties with a clear purpose: to create a property firm that operates with the same values as the clients it serves.

sari.name: Sari Wijayanti
sari.bio: Sari leads our sales team across all Indonesian markets. Her deep local network and acute market knowledge have been central to our presence in both Bali and Jakarta.

budi.name: Budi Santoso
budi.bio: With a background in architecture and ten years advising developers, Budi brings a rigorous design perspective to every development project we take on.

clara.name: Clara Reinholt
clara.bio: Clara manages the experience of every client from first contact through to transaction completion, ensuring our standard of service is consistent at every point.
